units: Kel. XIII, 8 התקינה לנר) to snuff, trim with a pin.
<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:1">Bets. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>מוֹחֲטִין את וכ׳</he> you may trim the wick; expl.
<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:1">ib.</cite> <he>עדויי חושכא</he> to remove the charred top; Y. ib. IV, 62ᶜ bot.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 90a">Sabb. 90ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 107a">Men. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>שמוחטין בה וכ׳</he> Ar., Rashi a. Ms. M. Men. (ed. <he>מחטטין</he>) it was used for trimming the wicks and cleansing the snouts of the candlestick.—[<he>מוֹחֶטֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="J00280"><he>יָחַט</he></cite>.]
